hypothesis: Control leads with the crew knowing where to be. This one leads with the offline promise: the schedule and the changes survive a basement, a backroad and a dead bar of signal. Same offer, different reason to click.

headlines.text: The whole week in one place

descriptions.text: The schedule works offline. Changes sync the moment the phone finds signal again.
Move a job and the crew sees it. No group text, no calls asking for the address.
Free to start. No credit card. Built by trades, for trades.
